entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand tracker. I need my money back, now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference! It was an impulse buy, I changed my mind, and I just don't use it. It's been sitting in its box. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand completely, and I can definitely help you with this. No need for a manager. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Fine. The email is angrycustomer@email.com. Just get it done.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th, which was 20 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Don't give me the runaround with some 'policy'. You're going to take it back. I'll post a review on every website you can imagine if you don't.
I understand your frustration, sir. Looking at our knowledge base here... yes, you're well within the return period. VeloFit has a 90-day return policy.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... good. So you're processing the return then?

Absolutely. Since you received it just 20 days ago, you are eligible for a full refund. I've just initiated the return process and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay. That's... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
